title: Layer-2 popovers take no focus and sheets do not trap it
body:
## Summary
The shared popover never receives focus and sits at the end of <body>; sheets are aria-modal but Tab leaves them. The Tumbler card also hides its focus ring.

## Description
`UI.popover` (prototype/shared/ui.js:260-275) appends the popover to the end of the document and leaves focus on the anchor, so a keyboard user who opens an ⓘ must Tab through the whole page to reach its content. `UI.sheet` (prototype/shared/ui.js:231-258) sets aria-modal and focuses its h2, but has no Tab containment, so focus walks into the page behind the scrim. The Tumbler card (`.tbody > .f`, prototype/tumbler/tumbler.css:134) is the element that takes Enter/W keys yet has `outline: none`. The app solved the same gap with `useModalFocus` (STATUS.md, 5bae3f2). Fixed: popover focuses its first focusable (or itself with tabindex=-1) and returns focus to the anchor on close; sheet wraps Tab; the card shows a focus-visible ring.

## Flow
- Tab to an ⓘ button, press Enter -> popover opens -> activeElement is still the button -> Tab goes to the next page control, not the popover
- open any sheet, press Tab past the last action -> focus lands behind the scrim
- fix in build order: popover focus + restore, sheet Tab wrap, tumbler card :focus-visible ring

## Expected impact
Keyboard and screen-reader users of every prototype can read Layer-2 detail; 93 UI.popover and 95 UI.sheet call sites across the prototypes inherit it. Could break: pages that rely on focus staying on the anchor after opening a popover (none found by grep).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - Layer-2 content reachable by keyboard
Before: 0 of 2 layer types move or contain focus; 93 popover + 95 sheet call sites (grep)
After: not built; predicted 2 of 2
Method: simulation - read ui.js and walked the ⓘ flow; not built because the round brief asks for cards over rewrites in frozen prototypes
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence:
prototype/shared/ui.js:260-275 (popover: appendChild to body, no focus call)
prototype/shared/ui.js:231-258 (sheet: aria-modal, h2.focus(), no Tab handler)
prototype/tumbler/tumbler.css:134 (.tbody > .f { outline: none })
grep: UI.popover( 93, UI.sheet( 95
instrument: jsdom probe: focus an ⓘ (data-pop) in prototype/main, click it, assert document.activeElement is inside .ui-popover; open UI.sheet, focus its last action, dispatch Tab, assert focus stays inside .ui-sheet (red today, green after)

title: Committed prototype gallery live-links two git-ignored contest variants
body:
## Summary
prototype/index.html, as committed, links and iframes Home v1 and v2 from `.contest/`, which is git-ignored, so a clean clone has 6 broken references on the gallery.

## Description
`variant()` in prototype/build-index.mjs:46-50 points Home v1/v2 at `../.contest/arena/.../variant-n/`; the generator checks existence on the machine that runs it (build-index.mjs:62), so on the owner machine it emits live cards and that output is committed. `.contest/` is ignored (.gitignore:1). In a clean archive of HEAD the link check finds 2 unique dead URLs, each used 3 times (card link, title link, iframe data-src). Fixed: contest entries emit a "local only" card with no live link unless a flag asks for them, so the committed file is clean wherever it was built.

## Flow
- git archive HEAD prototype -> open prototype/index.html -> Home v1 / v2 cards -> 404 in the preview and on click
- fix: build-index.mjs emits contest cards as local-only (no href/iframe) by default; regenerate index.html to a temp path, diff, then commit

## Expected impact
Anyone opening the gallery from a fresh clone sees two labelled placeholders instead of two broken previews. Could break: the owner loses the live Home v1/v2 previews unless the flag is passed.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no dead links in the committed gallery
Before: 6 broken refs (2 URLs x 3) in a clean git archive of HEAD (link checker over 46 html/css files, 425 refs)
After: not built; predicted 0
Method: probe - git archive HEAD + link checker for Before; After needs the generator change
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence:
prototype/build-index.mjs:10,46-50,62
.gitignore:1 .contest/
clean archive link check: index.html -> ../.contest/.../variant-1/index.html, ../.contest/.../variant-2/index.html (x3 each)
instrument: git archive HEAD prototype into a temp dir, run the link checker (href/src/data-src/url()) over it: 6 broken today, 0 after; regenerate with build-index.mjs into a temp copy, never in place

title: Tumbler NOTES says the prototype bar links do not resolve; they all do
body:
## Summary
prototype/tumbler/NOTES.md lists a known limit that shell.js links do not resolve from the tumbler folder; shell.js takes data-root and the tumbler passes it, so every link resolves.

## Description
NOTES.md "Known limits" (last bullet) says `shell.js` computes links for `pages/<page>/variant-n/` only. shell.js now reads `data-root` (prototype/shared/shell.js:155,161) and prototype/tumbler/index.html:103 passes `data-root="../"`. Checked: all 36 page/variant targets plus index.html exist from that root. A reader trusting the note avoids the bar. Fixed: delete the bullet.

## Flow
- open prototype/tumbler/index.html -> click any page in the top bar -> it opens (the note says it would not)
- fix: remove the stale bullet from NOTES.md

## Expected impact
The tumbler notes stop claiming a defect that is gone. Nothing can break.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - docs match the code
Before: 1 stale claim; 0 of 37 bar targets broken from the tumbler root
After: not built; predicted 0 stale claims
Method: probe - resolved every shell.js href(slug,v) against the files
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
prototype/tumbler/NOTES.md (Known limits, last bullet)
prototype/shared/shell.js:155,161 (data-root)
prototype/tumbler/index.html:103 data-root="../"
instrument: for each [slug,v] in shell.js PAGES x 1..3, resolve href from prototype/tumbler with root ../ and assert the file exists (37/37 today); then grep NOTES.md for the bullet (1 -> 0)

title: Frozen prototypes predate the words rules: vendor names and internals on screen
body:
## Summary
The prototypes still show a market-data vendor name (53 rendered occurrences in prototype/pages/*) and internals (Rust, MCP, env var names, REST paths) that the app words guards forbid. Whether frozen design records must obey the current words rules is an owner call.

## Description
UX-GUIDE: PayPal is the only vendor name; AGENTS.md: no vendor product names or internals in user-facing strings. This round removed the vendor name from the shared fixtures and the Dial (f95d70c), but 53 rendered occurrences remain inline in prototype/pages/* (other contexts), and prototype/main/modules.js still says "Checked in Rust" (:299), "no tools and no MCP servers" (:297), "$CLAUDE_CODE_BIN · found" (:863), "GET /v2/checkout/orders/…" (:557, :694). These are design records the owner chose on 6 Oct; rewriting them changes the record. Options: (a) mark the prototypes as pre-guard design records in the README / gallery lede and leave them; (b) run the words guard over prototype/ and conform them.

## Flow
- open any Shield/Tables/Setup variant -> the vendor name appears in rule lines and source cells
- open prototype/main -> Spend -> ⓘ on the gate -> "Checked in Rust"

## Expected impact
Decides whether a reviewer reading a prototype sees the same vocabulary as the app. Could break: (b) rewrites 39 owner-approved records.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - one vocabulary across records and app
Before: 53 rendered vendor-name occurrences (jsdom probe over 39 pages), 5 internals sites in modules.js
After: (a) 53 with a label; (b) 0
Method: probe - jsdom render count; the choice between (a) and (b) is a direction call
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence:
jsdom probe (text + title/aria/placeholder, modules and deals opened): TOTAL 57 before f95d70c, 53 after; top: pages/shield/variant-3 9, pages/shield/variant-1 7, pages/shield/variant-2 7, pages/tables/variant-2 7
prototype/main/modules.js:297,299,557,694,863
instrument: jsdom render-count probe over all 39 prototype pages for the vendor name and the internals list

title: Deduplicate the page list and verdict map between build-index.mjs and shell.js
body:
## Summary
PAGES and CHOSEN are hand-copied in prototype/build-index.mjs:13-29 and prototype/shared/shell.js:163-172.

## Description
Two copies of a 13-entry list. Compared entry by entry: identical slugs, order and chosen variants (shell.js omits home by design). The prototypes are frozen since the 6 Oct verdict, so the lists will not change again.

## Flow
- diff the two lists -> 0 differences

## Expected impact
None measurable: drift is 0 and the lists are frozen.

## Evaluation

Before: 0 drifted entries of 13
After: 0 drifted entries of 13

Result: not-better
